status_note: not a bug: out of scope upstream ([#8531](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8531), [comment](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8532#issuecomment-6035457336)). Unchanged on 30.29.0 and main (bdaf7d1, 2026-11-04).
summary: Transpiling between dialects keeps the text of an operator whose meaning differs: `transpile("select 7/2", read="postgres", write="duckdb")` gives `SELECT 7 / 2` (3 in Postgres, 3.5 in DuckDB). With a schema plus `annotate_types`, it becomes `CAST(TRUNC(a / b) AS BIGINT)` (right value, BIGINT where Postgres gives INTEGER).
handling: sverify never uses SQLGlot's transpiler for semantics (#231); the lift's profiles decide. May be a known limitation upstream, not a bug: check their docs and issues first.
